title: YURI Workcell Worker Packet
description: Bounded task packet dispatched to a single Sonnet worker lane. Runtime validation is performed by buildWorkerPacket and validateMemoryCapsule in yuri-workcell.mjs.

filesInScope.description: Repo-relative paths the worker is permitted to read and emit patches for.

dagValidation.description: DAG validation result from the decomposition this packet belongs to.

expectedOutputSchema.description: Schema ID the worker must conform to when emitting its output bundle.

memoryCapsule.description: Cross-file $ref by $id. These schemas are reference contracts, not runtime-resolved; if using Ajv, register capsule schema first.
